# AS Adventurer Creator

> A VTuber and PNGtuber asset creation pipeline. Four stages in a single page,
> backed by a local server that proxies two external services. This repository
> is a TypeScript fork of a JavaScript original.

The application converts a static sprite into a transparent looping animated
model. Stages communicate through a shared handoff object rather than a router
or a store. The server runs TypeScript directly through native type stripping,
while the browser half is compiled to ECMAScript modules.

When generating code for this project, consult the agent onboarding file and
the architecture documents first, then confirm details against the source.
